primary.title: Buying two flats and joining them? ITAT ruling clarifies when you can claim capital gains tax exemption
primary.summary: The ITAT has ruled that two adjoining flats may qualify as one residential house for Section 54F capital gains tax exemption if they are physically connected and used as a single home. The benefit remains subject to verification by the Income Tax Department.
